name: Check payroll inputs before the cut off

why: A dated payroll set-up plan and accountant questions for a business hiring its first employee, before the pre-check cycle starts.

why: Market ranges, pay bands and a bonus and benefits plan, matching the pay bands skill and the benefits prompt.

why: Builds a raise case, script and replies, the same job as the pay raise case prompt.

name: Prepare a fair promotion discussion
why: Matches work evidence to promotion criteria, the step behind moving someone between levels.

name: Sales pay plan checker
why: Checks what a commission plan rewards and ignores against churn by rep, as in a commission plan review.

name: Incentive checker
why: Finds where a pay plan pulls the wrong way, the test every commission or bonus plan should pass.

name: Hire, pay and measure a sales team on what works
why: Links hiring, the pay plan check and early success signs for a growing sales team.

name: Recognition plan designer
why: Non-cash recognition to sit alongside pay, useful when the budget for raises is tight.

name: Review employee data access before a change
why: Checks who can see pay and personal data before connecting a new payroll or HR tool.
